description: This is a PHP source class definition for API parameter handling related to deleting relationships in SuiteCRM. It extends a base parameter class and configures specific parameters such as module name, ID, linked field name, related bean ID, and source bean, including validation and default setting logic.

classes.name: DeleteRelationshipParams
classes.description: Defines and manages parameters for deleting a relationship between beans via API call, with validation and default value configuration.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module related to the relationship.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the primary bean.

methods.name: getLinkedFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the link field for the relationship.

methods.name: getRelatedBeanId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the related bean involved in the relationship.

methods.name: getSourceBean
methods.description: Returns the source bean object from the parameters.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Sets up parameter options, validation rules, and default values for the API parameters.
